minutes.headline: Board of Health granted septic variances at three properties and continued the Woodland Road request to March 15 for well information.
minutes.summary: The Board of Health, meeting remotely, heard Title 5 and local septic variance requests. It granted variances at 466 Mass Ave, 75 Roof Street and a Townsend Harbor Road property. It continued the Woodland Road request to March 15 so the well can be checked and the owner consulted. The agent also briefed the board on COVID-19 phase changes and vaccine clinics, and the board discussed moving the March 15 meeting earlier because of the town caucus.

votes.motion: Grant local upgrade approval and Title 5 variance for 466 Massachusetts Avenue (reduced groundwater offset).
Grant the Title 5 and local variances for 75 Roof Street, with a condition on the new well.
Grant three variances (two Title 5, one Lunenburg) for the Townsend Harbor Road property.

decisions.decision: Woodland Road local upgrade request continued to 7:15 on March 15 so well information and a well test can be obtained and the owner consulted.
The new-well requirement at 75 Roof Street will be written as a condition of the permit.
If the caucus is on March 15, the board will meet earlier that evening and limit the agenda to the two items already scheduled.
310 Sunny Hill Road withdrew its groundwater offset request and will use a fully compliant system.
A site at 244 Pleasant Street must return for new variances because its system type changed; scheduled for the first April meeting.

what_happened.line: The Board of Health granted a Title 5 variance and local upgrade approval at 466 Massachusetts Avenue, voting unanimously.
The board granted three variances, two Title 5 and one Lunenburg, for a Townsend Harbor Road property.
The board took up variances at 75 Roof Street, with the new well to be a permit condition; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
The Woodland Road local upgrade request was continued to 7:15 on March 15 so well information and a well test can be obtained.
310 Sunny Hill Road withdrew its groundwater offset request, and 244 Pleasant Street must return for new variances because its system type changed.

why_it_matters: Septic variances decide whether a property owner can repair or replace a failing system on a tight lot, which touches groundwater and well protection near Lake Shirley and elsewhere in town.
The Woodland Road request is still open, so its outcome depends on a well test the board has not yet seen.
watch_next: March 15 at 7:15: the Woodland Road request returns, and the board may meet earlier that evening if the town caucus falls that day.
The first April meeting: 244 Pleasant Street returns with new variance requests.
